snippet.title: Oeuf Trailer, Coming March 2026
snippet.description:
Oeuf, a physicsy 3-D precisiony platformer egg game, will be released March 10, 2026 on Steam:

You can wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831080

Presskit for journalists here:
https://increpare.github.io/oeuf_presskit/

Thanks for popping by,
increpare
